destinations.title: The destinations our customers choose.
destinations.kicker: Routes, landscapes and recommendations to truly enjoy Mendoza.
destinations.whatsappMsg: Hi, I'd like to know more about {{name}} and the vehicles available to visit it.

items.name: Valle de Uco
items.description: Surrounded by vineyards and mountains, Valle de Uco brings together Mendoza's most exclusive wineries, high-altitude wines, and a food scene that wins over travelers from around the world.

items.name: San Rafael
items.description: Nature, wineries and crystalline lakes. San Rafael blends adventure and relaxation in one of southern Mendoza's most visited destinations.

items.name: Malargüe
items.description: Volcanoes, caves and snow. Malargüe offers some of Mendoza's most stunning landscapes and unique experiences for adventure lovers.

items.name: Gran Mendoza
items.description: The essence of Mendoza starts here: historic squares, local cuisine, nightlife, and quick access to the province's best wineries.

items.name: Potrerillos
items.description: Mountains, fresh air, and a turquoise reservoir. The perfect getaway to enjoy nature and adventure sports just outside the city.

items.name: Cañón del Atuel
items.description: A one-of-a-kind natural setting where water and wind have shaped spectacular landscapes. Ideal for rafting, kayaking, and unforgettable scenic drives.

reviews.title: What our customers say when they return the keys.
reviews.kicker: Thousands of kilometers traveled. These are their experiences.

items.name: Agustín Laiseca
items.text: The service is 10/10, always with great energy and very well organized. The cars are spacious and, every single time, spotless and ready to explore Mendoza. The payment options and the great attention are what really set this company apart. I'd choose them again and again.

items.name: Andrea Colamedici
items.text: A wonderful experience. The car was spotless, very comfortable for getting around Mendoza, and remarkably fuel-efficient. You can tell there's care and dedication in every detail. Highly recommended.

items.name: Natalia Mamani
items.text: I needed to sort out transportation quickly because I had events lined up and my car was in the shop. It was super practical. Being able to rent a vehicle is a lifesaver when you can't put your routine on hold. Highly recommended.

items.name: Bastiaan Willers
items.text: The perfect car — roomy and comfortable. Everything spotless and in perfect condition. The service, the attention to detail, and the price are the best. I recommend it.

items.name: Magdalena Romero
items.text: I loved the experience. The car was super clean, comfortable, and running beautifully. Ideal to explore Mendoza at your own pace and enjoy every landscape. The service was top-notch, warm and welcoming. I'd absolutely book again.
